text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Annual number of people affected by all natural disasters excluding
The total number of people affected is the sum of those injured, requiring assistance, and left homeless. Disasters include
events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods. Extreme temperatures are not included here
because their geographical and time coverage is poor, making consistent comparisons difficult.

tspan.tspan: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
